listen_host.description: IP address the Gemini server binds to. Use '127.0.0.1' for localhost-only or '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

listen_port.description: Port number the Gemini server listens on. Standard Gemini port is 1965.

tls_cert_path.description: Absolute path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required for secure connections.

tls_key_path.description: Absolute path to the TLS private key file (PEM format). Required for secure connections.

tls_enabled.description: Whether TLS is enabled. Disabling TLS is insecure and violates the Gemini protocol’s intent.

root_path.description: Absolute path to the default document root directory containing Gemini content (gmi, gemini files, etc.).

mime_types.description: File extension → MIME type mapping. Add or override as needed for custom content types.

vhosts.description: List of virtual hosts (hostnames) with custom root directories. Each entry defines a hostname and its document root.

hostname.description: Hostname for the virtual host (e.g., blog.gemini).

root.description: Absolute path to the document root for this virtual host.

max_goroutines.description: Maximum number of concurrent goroutines handling requests. Increase for high-traffic deployments.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous connections. Must be ≥ max_goroutines for safe operation.

log_file_path.description: Absolute path to the access log file. Set to '-' to log to stdout.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity. 'debug' is for troubleshooting; 'info' is production-sane.

rate_limiting_enabled.description: Whether to enable request rate limiting to prevent abuse.

rate_limit_rps.description: Maximum requests per second per client IP when rate limiting is enabled.

directory_listing.description: Whether to serve directory index pages when a directory is requested. Disabled by default for security.
